objectives.text: Tiba di rumah nenek. Lihat sekeliling.
objectives.text_en: Arrive at grandma's house. Look around.

objectives.text: Naiki loteng dan periksa peninggalan nenek.
objectives.text_en: Search the attic and grandma's belongings.

objectives.text: Temui Rara di kafenya. Tanyakan tentang masa lalu kota.
objectives.text_en: Meet Rara at her cafe. Ask about the town's past.

objectives.text: Dekati Pak Harto, sang detektif pensiun.
objectives.text_en: Approach Mr. Harto, the retired detective.

objectives.text: Cari jejak di Pasar Lama. Temui Mira si jurnalis.
objectives.text_en: Follow the trail to the Old Market. Meet Mira the journalist.

objectives.text: Temui seseorang di Pantai saat senja.
objectives.text_en: Meet someone at the beach at dusk.
Piece the truth together on the investigation board [L].

objectives.text: Ada yang belum terbuka di rumah nenek...
objectives.text_en: Something in grandma's house remains unopened...
Return to the attic. It is time to choose.
